cascade.does: The client's customers may draft into the client's SoR. The client institutes AINav. The client's two humans admit.
does_not: make the customer's AI a seat

control_equation: client utilizes AI × counterparties utilize AI × AINav failsafe × two-human control

failsafe.ainav: Failsafe and human control — two seats admit, then the write.
failsafe.client: Utilizes AI — drafts the privileged write.
failsafe.does: Keep the client's humans in control of writes drafted by the client's AI or by the client's customers' AI.

maps.maps_to: Govern and Measure via sealed DecisionRecords on the admit plane

maps.maps_to: Refuse undeclared automated SoR writes. Not a state-law opinion.

for.board: Fiduciary oversight of material AI write risk. Inventory of models is not a control. One admit plane plus second-record keep is.
for.examiner: First record is the SoR write. Second record is who admitted it. Off-switch evidence is that the plane can freeze. Not a filing.
for.owner: The controller who cannot let any AI post a journal without two seats, and who must be able to freeze writes without turning the business off.

must_have.why: Every new client AI is another unauthorized-write surface unless one human plane sits over all of them.

note: Catalog map only. One human plane sits over the client's AI estate. Not booked. Not a certification. Not a statute. Not recognized revenue. Do not invent counterparties, boards, or regulators. G12 legal stays open. The failsafe is Job C, not a fourth SKU.

off_switch.does: Fail-closed. No dual admit, no write. Humans freeze new grants. Inference may continue. Consequence does not.
off_switch.does_not: Power down Copilot, Agent 365, or the client's model.

reset.does: Return the admit plane to the last sealed DecisionRecord / Merkle root as the keep.
reset.does_not: Wipe production Business Central or Sales.

rollback.does: A compensating SoR write that itself requires dual admit. The second record shows the rollback was admitted.
rollback.does_not: Silent undo or a time machine.

plane_equation: failsafe × off-switch × reset × rollback × two-human control

first.note: Books of original entry. Not a second SKU. Not LIVE_PIN_OK.
first.what: The privileged SoR write after dual admit (journal, invoice, order).

second.note: Supporting books-and-records for examiners and the client's customers. Not a certificate.
second.what: Sealed DecisionRecord and Merkle keep of who admitted the write.

risks.harm: A client-AI or agent tool posts a journal, quote, invoice, or credit without two seats.
risks.note: This is the Job C incident. Dual admit is the failsafe. Not LIVE_PIN_OK.

risks.harm: Books and records cannot show who admitted the write.
risks.note: Sealed DecisionRecords are the keep artifact after P-ADM. Not a SOX opinion.

risks.harm: Claiming EU AI Act, NIST, or ISO 42001 certification that does not exist.
risks.note: This tree maps instruments. It does not certify. Counsel stays open (G12).

risks.harm: Treating Copilot, Agent 365, PIM, a Teams vote, or the Cloud Agent as seat_a or seat_b.
risks.note: The failsafe collapses. Client AI is not dual admit.

risks.harm: Selling an EU-ready story without a conformity assessment or counsel.
risks.note: Maps are not filings. Do not invent a notified body.

risks.harm: A BYO MCP or Dataverse tool writes Business Central or Sales around the admit plane.
risks.note: Owner blocks Dataverse MCP until paid U-DUAL. Tools are not seats.

risks.harm: The client's customer AI posts into the client's SoR without the client's two seats.
risks.note: The client institutes AINav. Counterparty AI is not a seat. Do not invent names.

risks.harm: The write landed and no sealed DecisionRecord exists for the examiner or the client's customer.
risks.note: Second record is P-ADM keep. It is not the SoR first record. Not a certificate.

risks.harm: The client adds Copilot, Agent 365, BYO models, and vendor bots with no one plane over the writes.
risks.note: Every new AI is another unauthorized-write surface. The umbrella plane is the must-have. Not a fourth SKU.

risks.harm: An incident happens and client AI keeps landing journals because nothing is fail-closed.
risks.note: The off switch is refuse-without-admit. It does not power down Copilot.

risks.harm: Someone unwrites a journal, invoice, or order without two seats.
risks.note: Rollback is a compensating write that itself requires dual admit. Not a time machine.

risks.harm: The board has an AI inventory and no evidence of who admitted the write or that the plane can freeze.
risks.note: Board keep is P-ADM second record plus off-switch and reset evidence. Not a filing.

thesis: The client utilizes AI. The client's customers utilize AI. Every one of those systems can draft a privileged write. AINav is not that AI. It is the human control plane that sits over all of them: failsafe, off switch, reset, rollback, first and second records. Client or counterparty AI drafts. The client's two humans admit. Then the write. No admit, no write.
umbrella_equation: every client AI × one admit plane × two-human control
